title: Verification Workflow Protocol
description: Protocol schema for a plan-code-verify loop workflow with configurable phases, tasks, loops, approval gates, and externalized artifacts.

run_name.description: English short name for this workflow run. Filled by the Agent when generating workflow.json. Used to construct artifacts_dir.

artifacts_dir.description: Runtime. Path to the artifacts directory, created by the engine on first execution. Format: '.verification-workflow/<run_name>_<timestamp>/artifacts'. null until first step.

phases.description: Major phases in execution order. Extensible: add more phases (e.g. 'deploy') as needed.

tasks.description: All tasks across all phases, in execution order.

loops.description: Global loop configurations. Each loop can cross phases. Two trigger types: output_field (read task output) and approval_rejected (check approval status). Optional.

context.description: Runtime context. Populated by the engine during execution, not in declarations.

Phase.description: A major phase (e.g. plan, code, verify).

name.description: Phase identifier. Not a fixed enum — extensible to support future phases like 'deploy'.

tasks.description: Task names belonging to this phase, in execution order.

Task.description: A concrete task (minor phase). The core protocol unit.

name.description: Globally unique task identifier. Combined with 'phase' uniquely identifies the task.

phase.description: The major phase this task belongs to.

depends_on.description: Predecessor task names. Tasks execute serially; depends_on declares explicit ordering.

input.description: JSON Schema describing the input contract. Optional. If the handler is a skill, the skill's own SKILL.md may declare this; workflow.json may omit it and trust the skill.

output.description: JSON Schema describing the output contract (the content of the artifact file). Optional. Same self-contained rule as input.

requires_approval.description: If true, the engine pauses before executing this task and waits for human approval. Re-checked on every loop re-run.

started_at.description: Runtime. Timestamp of first execution attempt.

finished_at.description: Runtime. Timestamp of last execution attempt completion.

history.description: Runtime. Execution history, one Attempt per run. Loop re-runs append; never overwrite.

Handler.description: The execution body of a task.

type.description: skill = a sub-skill under skills/, executed by the Agent reading its SKILL.md prompt. script = an external script executed via bash.

ref.description: Relative path from the verification-workflow skill root. For skill type: e.g. 'skills/requirement_clarification'. For script type: e.g. 'scripts/run_test.py'.

Attempt.description: A single execution record of a task.

attempt.description: Attempt number, starting from 1. Increments on loop re-runs.

status.description: Execution outcome. Only these two states. Approval rejection also records status='fail'.

output.description: Output envelope. Two modes determined by the engine based on output.data structure: (1) Side-effect mode — if output.data contains a 'files' array, the engine writes those files to the real repository and stores only { changed_files, summary, passed? } here. No artifact file is created. (2) Artifact mode (default) — the engine externalizes output.data to an artifact file and stores { file, passed? } here.

file.description: Artifact mode only. Path to the artifact file, relative to the workflow.json location.

changed_files.description: Side-effect mode only. List of file paths written to the real repository.

summary.description: Side-effect mode only. Brief summary of what was done.

passed.description: Optional verdict flag, only for verdict-type tasks. Present in both modes. Stays in workflow.json for loop_controller to read directly.

approval_status.description: Only for tasks with requires_approval=true. null = not yet reviewed. approved = human approved, task may execute. rejected = human rejected, triggers approval_rejected loop.

reject_reason.description: Why the approval was rejected, if applicable.

Loop.description: A loop/backtrack configuration. Lives at the Workflow level (not Phase), since loops can cross phases. Two trigger types share the same checkLoops engine logic.

trigger_type.description: output_field = read a field from the trigger task's last Attempt output (uses trigger_field + trigger_when). approval_rejected = check if the trigger task's last Attempt approval_status == 'rejected' (ignores trigger_field/trigger_when).

trigger_task.description: Task name whose output/approval is checked for the loop condition.

trigger_field.description: Only for trigger_type='output_field'. Dotted path into the trigger task's last Attempt output. e.g. 'output.passed'.

trigger_when.description: Only for trigger_type='output_field'. The value that triggers the loop when the field equals this. Typically false for boolean fields.

target_task.description: Task name to jump back to when the loop triggers.

max_iterations.description: Maximum loop iterations before terminating the workflow. Counted globally per loop key, not reset across verdict-loop rounds.

Context.description: Runtime execution context. Populated by the engine.

current_phase.description: The phase of the task currently being executed.

current_task.description: The task currently being executed, or null if finished.

loop_counts.description: Map of loop_key -> count of times triggered. Key format: '<trigger_task>→<target_task>'. Each loop counts independently.
